analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($2,636.7) vs SMA5 ($2,548.65)/SMA20 ($2,491.15)/SMA50 ($2,273.3): Confirmed above short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($2,024.98)/SMA200 ($2,076.1): Mid-to-long-term trend strength advantage.
· 52-week position (34.8%) + Current price level is a recovery phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (50.4→65.8) + Entered overbought zone + Maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-22.9558→0.8614) + Improvement diagnosed + Confirmed bullish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Upper Band $2,629.02) + Approaching upper band, band width at 11.07% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,626.87) + Basis (Bollinger Mid-Band, SMA20 based).
· Swing Resistance ($2,663.05) + Potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) + Interpreted as a recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.65x) + Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend) + Conditions for entry/wait-and-see: RSI overbought cooling and volume recovery confirmation.
